labels.name: rounding
labels.definition: Values differ by small amounts because of how or when numbers are rounded.
labels.example: Legacy 103.73, new 103.72 for the same calculation.

labels.name: day_count_convention
labels.definition: Interest differs because the number of days or the year basis is counted differently (ACT/365, ACT/360, 30/360).
labels.example: New code accrues 29 days in February where legacy accrues 30.

labels.name: null_handling
labels.definition: A missing value is treated differently, for example as zero in one system and ignored in the other.
labels.example: Legacy charges the flat fee when the percentage fee is missing; new charges nothing.

labels.name: real_defect
labels.definition: The new code is wrong: a rule is missing, inverted or misapplied. Not explained by any other label.
labels.example: New code never charges the late fee.

labels.name: unknown
labels.definition: None of the other labels fits, or the evidence is not enough to decide.
labels.example: A difference with no matching rule in the extracted rules.
